title: Preserving animal products
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Boil and cool milk, make mala or yoghurt, and show a home cooler (a clay pot in a wet sand box or a charcoal cooler). Salt and dry thin strips of meat with the teacher.

skills.key_step: The child says why milk is preserved (it spoils fast; preserving saves food and money) and how at home: boil and cool, ferment into mala or yoghurt, keep cool in a clay pot, charcoal cooler or fridge, in clean covered containers.

floor.prerequisite: Knows how animal products are kept safe.
floor.question: Why keep milk cool?

representations: a clay pot in wet sand
steps: Or ferment into mala or yoghurt.

board.do: Draw a clay pot standing in wet sand.
Ask what happens to the milk inside.
Write "water evaporates and cools the pot".

listen_for: By leaving it raw in the sun
misconceptions.ask: How can milk be kept longer?
misconceptions.repair: Boil and cool one cup and leave one raw in the sun; smell both in the evening.
Mala and yoghurt are milk soured by useful microbes on purpose; they keep longer.
Old milk left in a can carries germs that spoil the new milk fast.

misconceptions.ask: How can milk be kept cool at home without electricity?
misconceptions.repair: Feel the inside of a clay pot standing in wet sand.

checks.question: Give two ways of preserving milk at home.
checks.answer: any two of boiling, fermenting, cooling

skills.key_step: The child says why meat is preserved (it spoils fast in warmth) and how at home: salting, boiling, drying thin strips, smoking, keeping cold and covered.

floor.question: Why cut produce thin for drying?

representations: pictures of nyirinyiri and smoked meat
steps: Dry on a rack under a net, or smoke.

board.do: Write "thick or thin strips for drying?".

listen_for: Leaving it wet in the sun
misconceptions.repair: Show nyirinyiri or biltong: thin strips salted and dried keep for weeks.

misconceptions.ask: How should raw meat be kept?
misconceptions.repair: Leave a piece of meat warm and uncovered and one cold and covered; compare.

misconceptions.ask: What does salting do to meat?
misconceptions.repair: Salt draws out water so germs cannot grow.

misconceptions.ask: Why is meat cut into thin strips for drying?
misconceptions.repair: Recall Grade 6: thin slices of fruit dried fast, thick ones rotted.

checks.question: Name two ways of preserving meat at home.
checks.answer: any two of salting, drying, smoking, boiling

checks.question: Why salt meat?
checks.answer: salt draws out water so germs cannot grow
